content.label: I got this app a long time a go, at least 5 years ago. It was a fun and nice way of tracking progress for habits that I was trying to build. Redownloaded it and was disappointed that they hadn’t really changed it at all. I would love a way to change the end time of your day it’s annoying to retroactively go through the calendar. Would love it if I could permanently change the end of my tracked day to 2am. When you set a streak to be weekly you should be able to revise the individual days you hit or missed. For such a simple idea and the fact that I payed money for it I wish they tried more new things. More ways of motivating you, more customization, just generally more care. It’s probably a kind of important app to a lot of people and there are more ways for the developers to show that they really care for the people who are trying to build and break habits. Basically it’s a cool app but feels like it could be much cooler.

THE main use I have for this app is on my Apple Watch. The only complications are dots and automatic "up next", which have literally never been what I need. Some watch faces I just want to see a single habit (like drinking water), but now I can't do that? Why remove features like that??
It helps me stay consistent and it’s a one time payment
You will build habits sooooo easily just by using this app

This app will take your money. There’s randomly too many screens. Nothing makes sense and when you try to follow the “tutorial” it only shows you how to complete the goal not how to actually work the app. What a useless app, even sharing goals with friends was weirdly complicated. Do not buy.

Would be amazing if this app had a standalone timer instead of having to create a habit pomodoro timer or use the timer in the time based habits. Also I don't know what exactly it is but the UI needs improvement it's not that nice to look at in my opinion.

Great app. 5 stars bc it deserves its flowers for helping people build healthy habits. 

One suggestion: make a “no more than” option for making a streak. For example, eating out, shampooing, drinks. Things that you aren’t trying to achieve but rather trying to limit to only a few times per week (or day).

i'm an aerospace engineering student with adhd and this app is very effective in helping me keep track of my most important habits (and things i want to quit). love how customizable it is without being overwhelming and the ability to add actions to habits (eg: i link my morning routine app). i also love that there's no subscription; it's 100% worth the $10. it also syncs very nicely between my ipad and my iphone, and i love that the ipad app is actually properly scaled to the size of the screen unlike some other apps i've tried. thank you so much!

2026-08-15
I can't even add all my habits to the control center. I also can't add habits via the shortcuts app because again, many are missing.

Great app but I’ve sent this to them and nothing has been done. The bridge for Screen Time doesn’t work. I’m not really sure if it’s on their fault or apples, but as a 8 year daily user of this app, I’m certain it doesn’t work

title.label: Generally okay, but I wish it was easier to mark tasks as complete through the widgets.

content.label:
The checkmark button to click on in order to mark tasks as complete through widgets is quite small and often missed when pressed. I’ve also noticed it has a pretty delayed reaction when clicking. Also wish there was an easier/alternative way to undo task completions, more easily accessible and visible besides shaking the phone to undo (which is only available immediately after accidentally marking a task as complete).

Still overall a helpful app, and looking forward to more app updates and improvements and bug fixes over time!

title.label: Great app! Make the number bigger.

content.label: The number of the streak on the widget. Its so little. Make it big, thats the dopamine, the motivator. Rest of the app is good.
I can’t find where to cancel and get refund I just downloaded but what I’m wanting it for doesn’t integrate with Apple

title.label: Tough to Operate with this App

content.label: I find this app difficult to use in a productive manner. More complicated than its simple look and built to have user add more costly features.
it bas been months waiting for any fix for the blank widget bug on apple watch.
I wish I could set frequencies as I wish, such as 1 time every quarter or 1x every 6 weeks. It would make me use this app.

Still figuring it out. Love all the options to customize colors and stuff with categories. I wish there was a way to either select a default view like always show my monthly calendar, I wish there was a way to put that on a widget. I wish there was a way to limit what screens you toggle through when you’re clicking a task, and I wish there was more of like a zoomed out dashboard view. I feel very claustrophobic within this app, but I think there’s a lot of potential.

title.label: This app has a poor memory

content.label: There are tasks that I am certain I completed the previous day, but when I attempt to complete them again, the system prompts me to indicate whether to credit the task to yesterday or today. This results in the loss of credit for the previous day’s completion.

title.label: Wishing for more dots per page

content.label: Streaks is awesome. I love the Apple Watch aspect. I wish I could fit more dots per page, like 3 columns, 4 rows, as I prefer to fit my whole day on a single page
Sneaky charges, no easy way to cancel. Negative stars.

This is a great app but with a critical missing feature. It lets you create streaks where you have a goal of “N per week.” This way you don’t have to do the task every day. However, you cannot see which days you completed that task. I’ll often wonder, did I already mark that task completed today? Or was it yesterday? The frustrating part is that there is even a calendar view… but it does not provide this info! Honestly without this issue I would give it 5 stars.

title.label: I use this app daily, and it is great, but…

content.label:
I’d really rather send this as suggestions to the developers because I use this app daily, and it really is helping me meet my goals.

1. For Break It Down, please remove the AI and let us add our own steps. 
2. Make an Add New Goal button, instead of having to go to the Gear button. (The Gear button = Settings. Settings ≠ New)
3. Add a Suggestion link so users don’t have to give you mediocre reviews.

title.label: Good, simple, but one l issue

content.label: I enjoy the app overall, and it genuinely is working to help me track my habits and do better. however, the weekly streaks is hard to edit/ view history of which days you completed the tasks or number of times you did the task that week. Considering the app was $6 for a pretty simple app with uncomplicated design (which is a good thing, but still), I am disappointed by the issue even though it is a relatively small one
So far I like it. Wish Tasks weren’t auto ALL CAPS. Not easy on the eyes & kinda ANGRY.
it only lets me record 1 day
This app costs $5.99, there is no free option

This app is a straight up scan. You have to pay the six hours, which I didn’t allow with nonetheless using the app to find out that the navigation of a customization of it is trash and the witches that they advertise are not available. This app is a straight up scam

I’ve used this app to work towards various different types of goals in the last few years. Accountability to only myself is often not enough for me, but as soon as I see those days start to add up on here, it gamifies my habits enough to get me to stay on track! I love how customizable it is and also the visual simplicity. The widget is great too. Streaks allows me to build and stack my habits over time and does a beautiful job of helping me accomplish my goals.
The app for me is too basic and does not make me want to come back and check in everyday. Theres no interaction.

I never write reviews for apps but I gotta appreciate how this is the one app that doesn’t need a subscription every month. No idea why that was ever normalized.

On top of this they make it so easy to use and this app has genuinely improved my life.

title.label: Best habit app worth every cent

content.label: I use this to keep track of all my habits. Great and very useful app. Worth the one time fee easily!

This app is designed to thoughtfully. I really love the responsiveness of the UX—it’s effortless and snappy. As far as habit tracking: it works well. I’m looking forward to seeing what future developments bring to the app. To the developer: excellent work! Thank you!

Only thing I would say is to add a feature to move the current streaks onto other pages. I like the satisfaction of all the icons turning glossy after completing all of them but I deleted one and I want to move another streak over but I can’t seem to do it. Adding this feature would make it six stars. Worth the money btw.

The screenshots of the Apple Watch appear to show complications that show an icon and day count… but these don’t actually exist! The only ones available are simple shortcuts to open the app. For me this was a waste of $6

title.label: Simple, yet powerful. Perfect for writing goals

content.label: I had one very specific use for this app. I am an aspiring writer and I needed a way to motivate myself to get in the habit of writing regularly. This app is PERFECT for that. I have a goal to write for 30 min 6 days a week. I love that I can set a timer right from the app. It is absolutely critical that they have a watch app too because my phone is often my source of distraction so being able to toggle things from my watch is perfect. I love that this is NOT A SUBSCRIPTION. Absolutely worth the one time cost. One of thing that is great is if you’ve been tracking with something else before this, you can retroactively add that data to the app so you don’t have to start from scratch. I’ve already written for more consecutive days using this app that I’ve managed in the last 6 months. I highly recommend.
Simple enough to use and awesome tool to stay accountable to my goals.  Love it.
Streaks is a great app! I was wondering if it’s possible to have a full-screen feature for Mac?

title.label: Simple fun app with manor accuracy issues

content.label: I love the UI on this app but unfortunately it’s fairly useless as the metros are way off. It can’t even calculate accurate percentage. Such a shame.

What a useless watch app. To use any widget it takes so many clicks. Completing the task is easier than getting a widget checked off. PLEASE update the watch widget/smart screen ability. I do not want to open the app on my watch, I just want to check off a box.

title.label: Wish I had found you sooner!

content.label: I have been in a funk for well over a year. Due to what doctors suspect is “Long Covid” I’ve struggled with self discipline, motivation and being social. This app helps me stay on track in such a gentle but constant path. That in turn helps with my mental wellbeing. Thank you!

Since there isn’t a trial period, you have to pay to see if you like the app. $5 or $6, so what…no big deal.

I really like the interface, and how well the widgets work. Habits/Tasks are easy to set up.

My only complaint is that there isn’t a List (bar style) set up for the tasks…. So, you can see more than 6 at a time. I think that would be pretty easy to implement. It would reduce some of the friction.

Other than that. Great app.
This app is great for helping remind me of all the little things I want to do on a regular basis, but don't want to add them to my already overflowing formal task management routine.
I don’t need to gamify my habits, I just need a gentle reminder. This app is perfect for that

title.label: Great app! I have some suggestions

content.label:
I love how the app syncs with other Apple apps. Very intuitive. 

It’s also a simple clean design! As others have said, very customizable.

My suggestions: 
1. A to-do list feature. I know the app is all about streaks (duh), but it’d be nice to have all the things I need to do in one place. Having a page for one-time tasks you can check off would be awesome. 

2. There’s a bit of a learning curve in the beginning. The help page has everything you need to know, but maybe a lengthier tutorial in the beginning would help people jump in quicker.

This app could be easier to navigate. All of a sudden I started getting notifications out of nowhere after a month. I still can’t figure out where to shut them in the app. I get that I can do it on my phone, but you would think it would be a choice on the main page but it’s all just confusing. I think I eventually found something like it but I’d like to turn them all off in one place and not individually.

All that to be said I like the colors and the point of the app but it should have a better main page and not the icons at the bottom that aren’t helpful.
Several apps have an annual view where you can see a visualization of one habit over the course of a year. You have annual stats but not the annual view. I’d love to see this feature!
